item.title: How Energy IT Solutions Are Transforming Modern Farming
item.description: Modern agriculture left behind the old image of tractors and sprinklers years ago. Today's farms look more like high-tech production facilities where every process gets optimized through sophisticated software and energy tech. The International Renewable Energy Agency reports that agriculture eats up roughly 30% of global electricity, making efficient energy management critical for farm profitability. Farmers face a double bind: boost yields while cutting environmental impact.

item.title: India’s Agricultural Reforms Move Toward Time-Bound, Transparent and Farmer-Centric Governance
item.description: Indian agriculture is shifting toward time-bound, transparent and farmer-centric governance, with renewed focus on timely payments, efficient credit, stronger monitoring, quality inputs, and faster research-to-field delivery.

item.title: Inaugural Day of Pusa Krishi Vigyan Mela Sees Strong Presence from Fertilizer Sector
item.description: IPL promotes sustainable farming at the Pusa Mela, highlighting the 6R principles to boost productivity, reduce costs, and support a "Self-Reliant India" through expert guidance.

item.title: AIOA-ICCOA Sign MoU at Amity University UP to Strengthen Academia–Industry Collaboration in Organic Agriculture
item.description: On February 26, 2026, an MoU was signed between the Amity Institute of Organic Agriculture (AIOA) and the International Competence Centre for Organic Agriculture (ICCOA) at Amity University Uttar Pradesh.

item.title: How Age and Lifestyle Affect Term Plan Calculator Estimates
item.description: Many individuals face uncertainty when planning long-term financial security for their families. The concern often revolves around how dependents would manage expenses and ongoing responsibilities after the demise of the primary income earner. Estimating the financial commitment required to secure adequate protection can also feel complex, especially when premium costs vary from person to person.

item.title: Story of a Woman Farmer from Rudraprayag Whose Determination Restored Land and Livelihoods
item.description: Sarita Devi, a farmer from Rudraprayag, revived degraded soil through natural farming after training with Art of Living. Her efforts boosted potato yield by 30%, restored soil health, and inspired other hill farmers.

item.title: The Invisible Workforce: Women Behind India’s Farms
item.description: Women perform the bulk of India’s agricultural labor yet lack land rights and recognition. Empowering these "invisible" farmers through training and ownership is essential for sustainable rural growth and productivity.

item.title: Cargill Highlights Scalable, Market-Ready Innovations under the theme of ‘Your Possibilities, Our Purpose’ at AAHAR 2026
item.description: At AAHAR 2026, Cargill showcased scalable, cost-competitive food innovations across five pillars - from protein fortification to premium chocolate - helping manufacturers navigate margin pressures and consumer trends with sustainable, market-ready, and application-led solutions.

item.title: New Delhi to Host Ground-breaking Global Conference on Women in Agri-Food Systems (GCWAS–2026)
item.description: New Delhi will host the Global Conference on Women in Agri-Food Systems (GCWAS–2026) from March 12–14, 2026 inaugurated by President Droupadi Murmu, bringing global leaders together to advance women’s empowerment and gender inclusion in agriculture.

item.title: DSR can reduce water use by up to 35% and cut cultivation costs by ₹14,000/ha; FSII calls for wider adoption
item.description: The FSII advocates for Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) to tackle water scarcity and labor costs. DSR can reduce water use by 35% and expenses by ₹14,000/ha through innovative seed technologies.
